meta.ogTitle: Book a Call — Everstead for Advisers
meta.ogDescription: We're working directly with our first cohort of IFAs, solicitors, and estate planners. Book a 20-minute call to see if Everstead fits your practice.

hero.title: We're onboarding our first adviser partners now.
hero.subtitle: Book a 20-minute call with the founding team. No pitch, no contract — just a conversation about whether Everstead fits your practice and your clients.

coverage.title: What we'll cover
benefits: See the co-branded client vault and how clients experience it between meetings
Walk through the adviser dashboard — readiness scores, document access, and client progress at a glance
Review the trust and data-protection model used in client conversations
Understand how Everstead fits alongside your existing tools without creating liability
Tell us what matters to your practice — we'll shape the session around you

infoCards.title: 20-minute session
infoCards.body: We confirm a time within one business day. Longer if you need it.

infoCards.title: Bring your team
infoCards.body: Include colleagues from legal, advice, operations, or client success.

infoCards.title: No liability created
infoCards.body: Everstead is an organisation tool, not a regulated service. We'll explain exactly where the boundaries are.

infoCards.title: IFAs, solicitors, and estate planners
infoCards.body: We're working with a small cohort across all three disciplines to shape how the adviser portal develops.

clients.label: Approximate number of clients you advise

notes.label: What matters most to you in this conversation?
notes.placeholder: Data handling, probate workflows, client experience, liability…

form.disclaimer: Everstead is an organisation and access tool — not a legal or financial service. No regulated advice is given on this call.

sent.title: We'll be in touch.
sent.body: We'll reach out within one business day to find a time that works. In the meantime, feel free to explore the security and data promise pages.
